searchQuery.term: best ai search visibility tools for small business

aiOverview.content:
The best AI search visibility tools for small businesses track how often your brand is mentioned, cited, and recommended across AI engines like  [Highlight start] ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews [Highlight end] .
- Otterly AI: Offers straightforward mention tracking, sentiment analysis, and on-page AI readiness audits across platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, and Google AI Overviews. According to Airefs, its Lite plan starts at $29/month, making it accessible for small teams getting started with AI visibility.
- Rankscale AI: Provides daily AI visibility monitoring with basic generative engine optimization (GEO) and traditional SEO integration. According to Dageno, it starts at $20/month, fitting solo operators or very small teams looking for low-cost tracking.
- Cituna: Tracks seven AI engines daily—including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Google AI Overviews, and AI Mode—and pairs visibility gaps with suggested content or authority fixes. According to Cituna, plans start at $39/month.
All-in-One SEO & Workflow Suites
- SE Visible (by SE Ranking): Combines AI visibility tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews with sentiment analysis and source URL identification to show where your brand needs citations. It suits small teams that want structured reporting and multi-region support without heavy enterprise complexity.
- Lumos: Tracks buyer-intent prompts, competitor benchmarking, and visibility scoring across models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, while integrating with Google Search Console and offering schema or page-edit recommendations. According to GetApp, it helps bridge traditional SEO data with AI citation tracking.
Small business marketers often balance simplicity and cost against how deeply a tool tracks specific AI engines and sources.
To narrow this down for your business, share:
- Your business type and audience (local brick-and-mortar, e-commerce, or B2B/service provider)
- Your monthly budget and whether you already use an SEO platform
- Which AI platforms matter most to your customers (such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, or Perplexity)
